'''2007 New York State Championship Kirk England DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kirk England]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kirk
* '''Deck name:''' Why, Steve, Y?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
